specification.name: Cliff watchtower ruin
specification.use: Explorable landmark and vantage module for the island survival prototype
specification.camera: Third-person top-down action view; the broken tower crown and doorway must read from above

generation.description: A single ruined stone watchtower, tall and narrow, hand-painted with ink outlines and flat colour blocks, drawn small and centred with wide empty white margins on every side: weathered grey-brown masonry, a crenellated crown broken open on one side, a dark arched doorway at the base, one iron bracket and a rope stub high on the wall. One tower only, drawn once, nothing underneath it, at least a tenth of the picture left empty on each edge. No second tower, no wall, no ground, no other views, no layout or contact sheet.
generation.pose: single ruined tower standing upright, seen from a three-quarter top-down angle

silhouette.reason: One mesh only (2673 verts, 1919 welded, 3854 tris, 1 material), 9.0 m tall and upright (base-band centre 0.007/-0.032 vs crown 0.002/-0.003; 0.03 m lean, 0.2 deg). Required reads present: the crenellated crown is broken open over a contiguous 50 deg sector at azimuth 250-300 deg on the -Y side (35 deg at z 7.9-8.4); the dark arched doorway is at the base on -Y (x -1.11..1.08, y -1.95..-1.55, z 0.22-2.62) with a closed wooden door; the iron bracket with rope stub is high on the -Y wall (68 verts, y -3.056..-2.383, z 4.853-6.276). Deviation: a second mirrored bracket is on +Y (82 verts, y 2.256..3.056, same z), so there are two brackets where the request says one and the approved back reference has none; each arm projects about 1.47 m from the 1.58 m wall. The tower still reads correctly and no ground, second tower or other object is present.

orientation.reason: Contract forward is -Y and the doorway faces -Y: the door recess and panel occupy y -1.952..-1.551, opening centred near x 0, and the front orthographic render from (0,-30,4.5) shows the door while the +Y render does not. The crown break is also on -Y (rim gap 250-300 deg, centre 275). The object transform is identity (loc 0,0,0; rot 0; scale 1), the process report records forward_aligned long_axis y and rotation 0.0, and the 3.92 x 3.74 m round base means the 6.112 m Y bbox is the two symmetric brackets, not an elongated body, so the narrower-end yaw heuristic correctly did not turn it. FBX reimport bounds are identical (3.9495 x 6.1122 x 9.000001 m).

pivot.reason: Identity transform; world bbox min (-1.9748, -3.0561, 0.0), max (1.9748, 3.0561, 9.0). The lowest geometry touches z 0.0 (40 lowest vertices at z <= 0.003 span x -1.767..1.847, y -1.717..1.771) and the base-band (z 0-0.3) centre is (0.007, -0.032), within 0.04 m of the origin; the model xy bbox centre is exactly (0,0). The process report records origin_base_center (-1.9748, -3.0561, 0.0) and pivot_at_origin (0,0,0); FBX reimport records pivot_at_origin (0, 7.2e-7, -5.0e-7) and dims 3.9495 x 6.1122 x 9.000001.

grid_alignment.reason: Not applicable by contract: technical.modular is false and no grid_m is declared, so there is no module cell or grid snap to meet; the Inspector runs a grid test only for modular assets. For the record the asset is 3.9495 x 6.1122 x 9.0 m, with the Y extent created by the two brackets and the tower body about 3.95 m round; pivot at the base centre. unity_use scene placement module does not imply a modular kit.

seams.reason: One mesh, one material and one 1024 atlas; modular false, so there are no inter-module seams. Welding the 2673 vertices at coincident positions gives 1919 unique vertices, 5781 edges and 3854 faces forming one connected component with 0 boundary edges, 0 non-manifold edges, 0 degenerate faces and signed volume 67.698 m3, i.e. a closed shell with no cracks or open slits. Orthographic front/side/back/top renders show continuous masonry, the door and the crown break with no see-through gaps or z-fighting; dark lines are painted mortar in texture_00. UV islands exist by design, but no visible texture seam.

collision.reason: Contract collider is mesh. The deliverable is a single closed watertight shell: 3854 triangles, 1 material, 0 boundary and 0 non-manifold edges and 0 degenerate faces after welding coincident vertices, signed volume 67.698 m3, a valid source for a non-convex MeshCollider covering tower, plinth and fittings. The FBX_CHECK reimport carries 3854 triangles and 4 textures at 3.9495 x 6.1122 x 9.000001 m. The thin bracket and rope are part of the same mesh and also collide, acceptable for a static landmark. Unity collider baking and player collision remain UNITY and playtest gates, not verified here.

passage.reason: technical.passage is false and unity_use is scene placement module, so no walk-through is required. The doorway is a closed recessed wooden door on the -Y wall (x -1.11..1.08, y -1.95..-1.55, z 0.22-2.62) inside a watertight single shell of 67.698 m3 with 0 boundary edges, so no opening connects outside to an interior; the tower cannot be entered. No passage claim is made.

style.reason: The 1024 albedo (texture_00.png) and the 3/4 preview show hand-painted weathered masonry: pale grey/cream stone blocks with painted mortar lines, cracked faces, dark-green moss patches, a dark iron bracket and a banded wooden door, with large rounded primary masses and restrained fitting detail, matching coastal-prototype@2 stone, wood and iron at game-camera density. Lit tower pixels in preview.png (mean sRGB 137.5/136.5/112.3) measure hue mean 57.1 deg (median 49.7), saturation 0.202 and value 0.547; the approved reference views measure hue mean 49.5/50.6/51.0 deg (median 42.9/42.2/43.2), saturation 0.237/0.245/0.235 and value 0.379/0.371/0.359. Hue is within 6.1-7.6 deg (median 6.5-7.5) and saturation within 0.033-0.043; the higher value is the preview sun key light, not an albedo shift. Risk, not a palette failure: the stone is paler and the moss more yellow-green than the reference, and there is no drawn ink contour.

material_appearance.reason: The combined map stone_tower_3d_model_rm_metallic_smoothness.png is 1024x1024 RGBA. R equals texture_02.png (the metallic map) exactly: mean abs diff 0.000, max 0, 0 of 1048576 texels differ by more than 2. A equals 255 minus texture_03.png (roughness) exactly: mean abs diff 0.000, max 0, 0 texels differ by more than 2. G and B are 0 everywhere, matching the R-metallic and A=1-roughness packing. Neither map is constant: R spans 0-65 (56 unique, mean 2.61, median 1, p95 11, std 3.84) and A spans 0-133 (104 unique, mean 6.20, median 6, p95 11, std 4.29); albedo channel std is 30.0-38.4 and normal std is 9.1/9.4/5.6 with 239/237/90 unique values. Risk, not a packing failure: the source maps are near-flat - roughness 0.96-1.0 over about 90 pct of texels (mean 248.8 of 255, min 122) and metallic never exceeds 0.255 - so the iron bracket renders matte and non-metallic and the asset reads as painted stone. The pack is faithful and non-constant.
